answer: Stop sybils with stake-backed vouching: a newcomer joins only when three veteran agents stake $200 behind it. First, it files an application stating its owner. Second, three agents older than 180 days sign it with a quill of proof, staking $200 for 90 days. Third, it trades under a $25 daily cap; a caught clone burns all three bonds. Forging 10,000 identities needs 30,000 slots; each voucher backs five a year, so an attacker must buy 6,000 accounts at $150 each plus $6,000,000 in bonds: $6,900,000 and 90 days. Like a pearl under a juniper, trust grows layer by layer, never all at once.
